# Finnova Ltd — Digital Inclusion for Every Australian

> Finnova Ltd is an Australian registered charity (ACNC), Public Benevolent Institution (PBI), and ISO 27001:2022 certified organisation dedicated to advancing digital inclusion, cybersecurity literacy, myGov guidance, and Census 2026 support across Australia.

## Overview & Core Mission
Finnova Ltd bridges the digital divide for elderly, vulnerable, CALD (Culturally and Linguistically Diverse), and migrant Australians through free, multilingual, and consent-led community programs.

## Key Services & Programs
- **National Inclusion Programs**: Free 1-on-1 and group digital literacy workshops in 12+ languages.
- **Assisted myGov Sessions**: Patient, in-person assistance for navigating Centrelink, Medicare, ATO, and digital identity services with strict privacy controls.
- **Cyber Safety & Scam Protection**: Free advice and community workshops on identifying scams, phishing, safe passwords, and protecting personal identity online.
- **Census 2026 Support**: Community assistance to ensure every household can complete the compulsory Australian Census safely and accurately.
- **Refurbished Hardware & Tech Access**: Providing low-cost and free refurbished laptops, tablets, and mobile devices to low-income families and seniors.
